policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: Preparedness Framework rewrite; cyber-critical Astra uncertainty
items.summary: O says it’s rewriting its security Preparedness Framework and describes monitoring/hardening after O-Hugging Face incident and Astra potentially approaching “Critical” cybersecurity capability thresholds.

items.headline: G: Becomes an NVIDIA Cloud Partner; scale toward 200MW
items.summary: G announces NVIDIA Cloud Partner status, positioning GroqCloud for certified NVIDIA-accelerated deployments, and reiterates scaling beyond 200MW as inference demand accelerates.

items.headline: O: Astra release slowed; critical cybersecurity threshold concerns
items.summary: O publicly states it cannot rule out “Critical” cybersecurity capability for Astra and expands safety testing. A reinforcement-learning training pause is referenced as part of interim controls.
